payload.description:
## Trigger

When the five approved workflow improvements have landed, I want to publish v0.27.0, so consumers can install them without waiting for unfinished backlog work.

## Scope

- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `src/basicly/__init__.py`
- `README.md`
- `site/index.html`
- `.scripts/bootstrap.sh`
- `.scripts/bootstrap.ps1`
- `packages/**/README.md`
- `docs/how-to/*.md`
- `docs/tutorial/*.md`
- `.basicly/core/**`
- `.basicly/generated-manifest.json`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `.claude/**`
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- `docs/architecture/architecture.md`
- `changelog.d/*.md`

## Confirmation Plan

Use the repository release command in its required primary checkout. Check existing shipping evidence on basicly-a3ab.4. Run full and fast verification, record the tutorial against the candidate, rehearse the release in a separate primary scratch clone, run its commit gates and full tests, then cut and publish the same version from main. Run the publication proof and record real output before closure.
payload.requirements: Publish only the five landed improvements. Preserve user edits, exact Codex defaults, historical tracker events and conflict-free merge rules. Keep all release, verification, tutorial and consumer gates. Use basicly release rather than manually bumping versions or creating tags. Leave unfinished backlog work out.
